text: My day follows a steady rhythm that keeps me feeling grounded and productive. I wake up at six-thirty each morning, starting with a glass of water and ten minutes of stretching to shake off sleep. After a quick shower and a simple breakfast of oatmeal and fruit, I’m at my desk by eight. My work schedule is fairly predictable: I tackle challenging tasks in the morning when my focus is sharp, and reserve afternoons for meetings and emails. Around five, I switch off completely and go for a thirty-minute run or bike ride. After dinner, I unwind by reading a novel or chatting with friends online. This consistent routine gives my days structure and balance.
